title: Meet NASA's 2020 Earth Expeditions
description: Did you know NASA studies snowstorms, sinking coastlines, wildfires and many other processes affecting life on Earth? Join our experts live as we preview five new airborne science campaigns taking to the field in 2020 to explore questions critical to understanding our home planet.
keywords: Earth Expeditions, Wildfires, Armstrong Flight Research Center
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
